_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, SKILL.md, docs, reference data, and metrics ABOUT THE SKILL. Public.
FIXTURE = synthetic test data. This repo ships no test suite, so the list is empty.
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Versioned only in the PRIVATE companion. Lives in the private companion
config, resolved at runtime by tools/datadir.py. This repo ships only the schema.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and in CI.
_audited: Real writers check that actual destinations sit in a separate Git worktree outside this public source tree (path checks only; visibility is not checked at runtime) before corpus, pool, ledger, archive, receipt, run-state, cursor, daemon-log or backup writes. Explicit invalid configuration fails closed. Source data remains empty because each writer resolves outside the public consumer and cannot use a repository-local fallback.
_readme_diagrams: TOOL: docs/diagrams/*.dot, *.png and render.py describe the shipped workflow using public code and documentation; they contain no real-run observations.
_data_home: PRIVATE companion pool/ by default, overridden by DEMAND_MINING_DATA_DIR; every actual destination is path-checked before writes. See docs/runtime-contract.md.
